spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The zealot casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Aberrant Form
entries: The zealot exudes the chaos of the Far Realm. Any non-Aberration creature that starts its turn within 5 mètres of the zealot doit réussir on a {@dd 15}Sagesse saving throw or take 7 ({@dégât 2d6}) psychicdgts.

trait.name: Weirdly Pliable
entries: The zealot, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, is unnaturally flexible. The zealot can move through any space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zealot makes one Psychic Rend attack and two Shortsword attacks.

action.name: Psychic Rend
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 15 m, or portée 120 m,, une cible. {@h}14 ({@dégât 3d6 + 4}) psychicdgts, and la cible doit réussir on a {@dd 15}Sagesse saving throw or have the {@condition étourdi} condition until the start of the zealot's next turn.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 15 m,, une cible. {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d6 + 4}) piercingdgts plus 7 ({@dégât 2d6}) psychicdgts.

bonus.name: Void Warp {@recharge 5}
entries: The zealot teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet of itself, leaving a churning void in the space it left. Immediately after it teleports, each creature within 30 feet of the void other than the zealot must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) force damage and is pulled to the unoccupied space closest to the void. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. The void then disappears.

items.name: Mind Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: The zealot magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) psychic damage and have the {@condition stunned} condition for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition stunned} condition on itself on a success.

items.name: Ash Cloud
entries: When the zombie dies, it leaves a cloud of ash that lasts for 5 minutes but does not obscure vision.

items.name: Severed Head
entries: Chishinix is always accompanied by a {@creature Chishinix' Head|PaBTSO|severed head}.

trait.name: Avoidance
entries: Si  mutate is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only halfdgts, it instead takes nodgts if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only halfdgts if it fails.

trait.name: Light Sensitivity
entries: While in bright light, the mutate désavantage aux jets d'attaque.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mutate makes one Corpse Swipe attack and two Tail attacks, or it makes four Tail attacks.

action.name: Corpse Swipe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}20 ({@dégât 3d10 + 4}) bludgeoningdgts. If la cible is une créature, it doit réussir on a {@dd 16}jet de sauvegarde Constitution or have the {@condition empoisonné} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition empoisonné} in this way, une créature can't regaintouché points.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, une cible. {@h}13 ({@dégât 2d8 + 4}) slashingdgts.

bonus.name: Phantasmal Duplicates
entries: The mutate magically projects up to four illusory copies of itself. These duplicates make it difficult to ascertain the mutate's true location and last until the end of the mutate's next turn. While the copies exist, attack rolls against the mutate are made with disadvantage.

bonus.name: Psychic Moan {@recharge}
entries: The mutate lets out a moan charged with psychic energy. Each creature within 60 feet of the mutate that isn't an Aberration must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 5d6}) psychic damage and have the {@condition frightened} condition until the end of the mutate's next turn.

entries: The skeleton avantage onForce andDextérité saving throws made against effects that make it have the {@condition à terre} condition.

If this attack reduces la cible to 0touché points, la cible immediately dies and is consumed by the cluster.

entries: The cluster bulges and spews {@dice 1d4} mature eggs. Each egg lands in an unoccupied space of the cluster's choice within 30 mètres of itself and immediately transforms into an {@creature encephalon gemmule|PaBTSO}. The gemmules obey the cluster's commands and take their turns immediately after it.

reaction.name: Aggressive Hunger
entries: Immediately after being hit by an attack, the cluster moves up to its speed toward the attacker. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. If the cluster ends this movement within 5 feet of the attacker, it then makes one Slam attack against that attacker.

senses: blindsight 30 ft. (can't see beyond this radius)

trait.name: Encephalon Progeny

trait.name: Résistance à la magie

action.name: Psychic Slam

entries: The gemmule targets one creature within 5 feet of itself and forces the target to make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the gemmule enters the target's space and attaches to the target. While the gemmule is attached, the target takes 7 ({@damage 3d4}) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns, and the gemmule can't use Leech again until it detaches. It can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. As an action, the target or a creature within 5 feet of the target can detach the gemmule by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Strength check.

bonus.name: Consume Creature
entries: The flesh meld targets one Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of itself that it's grappling. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the flesh meld. The flesh meld can have one creature swallowed at a time.

A swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition grappled} condition. While swallowed, it has the {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained} conditions, has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the flesh meld, and takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage at the start of each of the flesh meld's turns. If this damage reduces a swallowed creature to 0 hit points, the creature dies, and the flesh meld consumes its body.

If the flesh meld takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the flesh meld must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls with the {@condition prone} condition in a space within 5 feet of the flesh meld. If the flesh meld dies, the swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition prone} condition.
